name: block-testimonials
title: Testimonials block
description: Quotes with their authors, as figures with blockquotes.
a11y: Each quote is a figure with a blockquote and a figcaption.
Avatars are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading shown above the quotes.

props.name: items
props.description: The quotes to show, each with `quote`, `name` and optional `role` and `avatar`.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Outline level of the section title, 1 to 6. Default 2.
